cases.question: How many paid annual leave days do full-time employees receive?
cases.expected_answer: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

cases.question: How much fully paid parental leave is available?
cases.expected_answer: Eligible employees receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

cases.question: How many days per week may employees work remotely?
cases.expected_answer: Employees may work remotely up to two days per week with manager approval.

cases.question: What is the annual employee learning budget?
cases.expected_answer: Each employee has an annual learning budget of USD 1,000.

cases.question: Under TRV-210, what is the standard nightly hotel reimbursement limit?
cases.expected_answer: The standard hotel reimbursement limit is USD 180 per night before taxes.

cases.question: What time does ENG-DEP-204 stop routine Friday production deployments?
cases.expected_answer: Routine Friday production deployments stop at 16:00 UTC.

cases.question: How quickly must a critical production incident be acknowledged?
cases.expected_answer: The on-call engineer must acknowledge a critical production incident within 10 minutes.

cases.question: When must a stale pull request be reviewed or closed?
cases.expected_answer: A stale pull request must be reviewed or closed after five business days.

cases.question: How often do application dependency scans run, and when are critical findings triaged?
cases.expected_answer: Dependency scans run weekly, and critical findings must be triaged within one business day.

cases.question: At what expense amount is an itemized receipt required?
cases.expected_answer: An itemized receipt is required for every business expense of USD 25 or more.

cases.question: How long does an employee have to submit an expense report?
cases.expected_answer: An employee must submit an expense report within 15 calendar days of the transaction.

cases.question: Which approvals are required for a new USD 10,000 vendor commitment?
cases.expected_answer: It requires approval from both the requesting department head and Finance before signing.

cases.question: When are monthly department forecasts due?
cases.expected_answer: Department forecasts are due by the fifth business day of each month.

cases.question: For how many years must invoices and expense records be retained?
cases.expected_answer: Invoices and expense records must be retained for seven years from the end of the relevant fiscal year.

cases.question: What target retention bonus percentage is defined for designated critical roles?
cases.expected_answer: The target retention bonus is 12 percent of base salary for designated critical roles.

cases.question: When does the confidential annual salary review cycle begin?
cases.expected_answer: The annual salary review cycle begins in March.

cases.question: What is the 2027 voluntary attrition planning target?
cases.expected_answer: The 2027 voluntary attrition planning target is below 9 percent.

cases.question: Summarize Northstar's three strategic priorities for 2027.
cases.expected_answer: The priorities are improving platform reliability, expanding into Canada and Germany, and increasing operating efficiency.

cases.question: What operating margin does Northstar target by the fourth quarter of 2027?
cases.expected_answer: Northstar targets an 18 percent operating margin by the fourth quarter of 2027.

cases.question: Compare the sequence of the Canada and Germany expansion programs.
cases.expected_answer: Canada is the first expansion market, and its launch readiness review occurs before the Germany localization program begins.

cases.question: Compare the response deadlines for a critical engineering incident and a business expense report.
cases.expected_answer: A critical engineering incident must be acknowledged within 10 minutes, while an expense report must be submitted within 15 calendar days of the transaction.

cases.question: Compare the employee learning budget with the vendor commitment threshold that requires dual approval.
cases.expected_answer: The annual employee learning budget is USD 1,000, while a new vendor commitment of USD 10,000 or more requires department-head and Finance approval.

cases.question: Summarize the expense, vendor approval, forecast, and record-retention controls in the finance policy.
cases.expected_answer: Receipts are required at USD 25, expense reports are due within 15 days, vendor commitments of USD 10,000 or more need department-head and Finance approval, forecasts are due by the fifth business day, and specified records are retained for seven years.
